messages.subject: selectInput with optional entry
parts:
Is there a way of using selectInput with an optional entry?  I thought of using both textInput, and selectInput and checking if one was blank.  or maybe using dynamic ui.  But was hoping there was a default method of doing this.

To be clear, I want the UI to have a selectInput field, with the choice of entering the text data instead.
